_doc: Wave 7 reference cameras (tools/refcams/README.md), the same format as cameras.json and cameras_w6.json. One row a camera, each on its own line. Run with REFCAMS_JSON=tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json.

cameras.name: bonfire_night
cameras.label: The beach at 21:00 clear among the bonfire rings, groups round the fires, the surf and the pier's lights beyond

cameras.name: canals_day
cameras.label: Marisol Canals at 11:00 clear, on a Heron Canal footbridge looking north down the canal: houses on the water, docks, boats, bridges

cameras.name: stack_aerial
cameras.label: The four-level stack (the 110 under the 101) from 150 m up at 17:30 clear, from the north-west toward downtown, traffic on every level
